summary: Phase 2 Binance USDT crypto + 4-step checkout tested on preview. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_binance_crypto.py (19 pytests) covering admin settings, create_payment uniqueness/idempotency, watcher confirm/detect/expire paths, and all unmatched reasons (wrong_network, wrong_amount, wrong_address, wrong_memo, duplicate, unknown, deposit-after-expiry). All 19 pass. test_payment_fees.py (10/10) also passes with new conftest. Playwright e2e verified: BottomNav/GameButton hidden on /commande, PubG verify (mocked) auto-slides to step 2, Binance flow renders TRC20/TON/BEP20 cards and crypto-amount/qr/address/memo at step 3 (memo only on TON), manual flow has no reference field at step 2, shared BackButton exits on step 1 and goes to previous step on step 2.

minor.issue: backend/.env lacks PAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET → tests/test_payment_lifecycle.py cannot be collected (pre-existing; blocks lifecycle regression).
Hardcoded admin password 'Admin1234!' is wrong (preview uses MgsAdmin2026!) → all 7 cases ERROR at login. Pre-existing test bug, not Phase 2 regression.

issues: Cart icon in header remains visible on /commande; spec only says BottomNav+GameButton must be hidden, so this is informational only.

action_items: Fix tests/test_iter23_manual_fee.py credentials (change ADMIN_PASS to env var or MgsAdmin2026!).
Add PAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET to backend/.env (even a dummy) so test_payment_lifecycle.py can at least be collected in preview; else exclude it from the default suite.
critical_code_review_comments: services/crypto.create_payment: amount-unique retry loop uses random.sample(range(1,100), 99) — fine for 99 concurrent same-base amounts; after that returns 503. Acceptable.
binance_watcher._no_candidate: when `amount` matches an open slot on a different network, reports 'wrong_network' tied to that other order's payment_id — behavior matches spec. OK.
crypto_payments index enforces one open slot per (network, amount) and per order_id — good. tx_hash unique partial index prevents double-confirm.
routers/crypto.initiate rate-limited per IP (15/10min). Fine but tests must vary X-Forwarded-For.
orders.py line 167-171: binance payment_provider='binance' set only after available() check — correct.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (new; adds backend to sys.path and loads .env for all tests)

success_rate.backend: 100% on new Binance suite (19/19) + fees unit tests (10/10); pre-existing lifecycle/iter23 blocked by env/password issues unrelated to Phase 2

seed_data_creation: Created ~15 TEST_* orders + crypto_payments + crypto_unmatched rows during test run. Reset admin settings: binance.enabled=false, all wallets cleared, papi_auto=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Binance tests require sync pymongo for DB assertions + a single persistent asyncio loop (see _PERSIST_LOOP in test_binance_crypto.py) because motor's AsyncIOMotorClient binds to the first loop it uses. Run with `-n 0` because pytest-xdist loadscope parallelism conflicts with the admin-settings fixture that toggles binance.enabled. Set BACKEND_TEST_URL=http://localhost:8001 (or preview URL) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for test_iter23_manual_fee.py. Admin password is MgsAdmin2026!. Frontend uses mock on **/api/fazercards/pubg/validate-id (preview has no FazerCards key). Binance preview env has dummy keys so services.binance.configured() is True and crypto availability can be enabled via API.
